spec.name: M6.Pinned.enumerator_sdiff
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (B C : Finset (M6.Pinned.Vector m)) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins m), B ⊆ C → M6.Pinned.enumerator (C \ B) P = M6.Pinned.enumerator C P - M6.Pinned.enumerator B P
spec.guidance: Use sum_sdiff after unfolding enumerator. Finset.sum_sdiff yields additive equality. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Pinned.enumerator_zero_coeff
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : Finset (M6.Pinned.Vector m)) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins m), (0 : M6.Pinned.Vector m) ∉ L → (M6.Pinned.enumerator L P).coeff 0 = 0
spec.guidance: Use enumerator_coeff/count; weight zero implies all coordinates zero via card_eq_zero and filter membership. Then filtered set empty. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Pinned.enumerator_total
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : Finset (M6.Pinned.Vector m)), Polynomial.eval 1 (M6.Pinned.enumerator L (M6.Pinned.free m)) = (L.card : ℤ)
spec.guidance: All vectors agree with free pins. Expand enum and eval sums, X powers evaluate1. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
